add_virtual.title: Add a virtual thermostat
add_virtual.description: Home Assistant answers the controller as this thermostat, reporting the sensor's temperature. Use a device ID that no real thermostat has. After adding it, register it on a channel with the uponor_mqtt.register_virtual_thermostat action.

remove_virtual.title: Remove virtual thermostats
remove_virtual.description: Also unregister their channels on the controller, or it keeps polling a thermostat that no longer answers.
